# TechRound

> > TechRound is a comprehensive news and resource platform covering startup ecosystems, technology trends, and business guidance across the UK, Europe, and beyond.

TechRound provides daily tech and startup news alongside practical guides for entrepreneurs, covering fintech, AI, funding, compliance, and business operations. The platform serves as both a news source and educational hub for founders, investors, and business professionals.

## News & Coverage

- [TechRound Homepage](https://techround.co.uk): TechRound homepage: startup and tech news from UK, Europe, Middle East
- [Latest Tech News UK](https://techround.co.uk/news): Latest UK tech news covering fintech, AI, funding and product launches
- [Startups Features: Interviews, News & More](https://techround.co.uk/features/startups): Startup news, founder interviews and insights on SaaS and medtech
- [Tech News, Insights and Information](https://techround.co.uk/features/tech): Tech news and insights covering wearables, cybersecurity and digital trends
- [Business News, Interviews, Insights and Help](https://techround.co.uk/features/business): Business news, interviews and insights for startups and online growth
- [Finance Interviews, Insights and Information](https://techround.co.uk/features/finance): Finance news, guides and interviews covering crypto, markets and fintech

## Business Startup Guides

- [Starting a Business in the UK, Guides and Ideas](https://techround.co.uk/starting-a-business): Guides and resources for starting a business in the UK from home or office
- [Business Grants and Funding](https://techround.co.uk/business-grants-and-funding): Comprehensive guide to business grants, funding and crowdfunding options
- [How To Launch A Startup In Dubai](https://techround.co.uk/startups/how-to-launch-a-startup-in-dubai): How-to guide for launching startups in Dubai and UAE business environment
- [Self Employed and Sole Traders](https://techround.co.uk/self-employed-and-sole-traders): Guide to self-employment, sole trader setup and UK tax deductions
- [Guides and Useful Business Information](https://techround.co.uk/features/guides): How-to guides for startups, business, tech, finance and travel
